item.title: WHO chief urges end to US fuel blockade on Cuba
item.description: UN allocates $2m for immunisation and medical equipment as Cuban healthcare struggles with critical shortages.

item.title: Senegal fans celebrate AFCON legal victory over Morocco
item.description: Senegal have been reinstated as 2025 AFCON champions after the Court of Arbitration for Sport upheld their appeal.

item.title: Israel’s Eisenkot secures first coalition partner in bid to form government
item.description: The Yashar party says it agreed to sign a coalition pact with Israel's Our Home party, led by Avigdor Lieberman.

item.title: Iran whips singer Parastoo Ahmadi 74 times over YouTube concert
item.description: Iranian authorities have lashed singer Parastoo Ahmadi over a 2024 performance streamed live on YouTube.

item.title: Poll finds US voters want government to end Iran war regardless of terms
item.description: New survey finds that 55 percent of voters, including 80 percent of Democrats, want war brought to an end immediately.

item.title: Gunmen hold dozens hostage in Colombia supermarket
item.description: A group of armed men is holding around 20 people hostage in Cartagena, Colombia.

item.title: Alaska ends deal to give voter records to US Justice Department
item.description: The decision follows the conclusion of the 2026 midterm elections and an effort under Trump to gather state voter rolls.

item.title: Iran war live: Houthis threaten Saudi ports over coalition’s Hodeidah order
item.description: Houthis vow to target Jeddah and other Saudi ports if Hodeidah is hit, after the coalition issues an evacuation order.

item.title: Rebel group retreats in DR Congo after heavy clashes with government forces
item.description: CRP halts advance towards Bunia, citing commitments made during Ugandan-mediated talks with government.

item.title: South Africa convicts Zimbabwean who tried to fight Ukraine for Russia
item.description: The Zimbabwean man was arrested on November 8 at a Johannesburg airport while attempting to board a flight to Russia.

item.title: Arsenal and Dortmund draw 1-1 as Gyokeres goes from hero to villain
item.description: Arsenal dominate the chances as Borussia Dortmund fight back for a 1-1 draw in football's Champions League.

item.title: Bellingham stunner, Mbappe brace help Real Madrid rout PSV
item.description: Real Madrid come from behind to power past PSV Eindhoven with a 5-1 win in football's Champions League.

item.title: Todd Blanche declines to confirm if Nvidia’s Jensen Huang was investigated
item.description: The US attorney general refused to discuss claims by Donald Trump that his administration conducted a 'thorough' probe.

item.title: Colombian president blames ex-FARC rebels for car bomb blast
item.description: Colombian President De la Espriella blames the FARC for plotting a bombing that injured tens and pledges to retaliate.

item.title: China’s Huawei found guilty of trade secrets conspiracy, fraud in US trial
item.description: Jurors acquit the company of the most serious charge it faced of engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy.

item.title: Russian jets spark air raid alert in South Korea
item.description: South Korea’s residents were urged to seek shelter as Russian military jets approached its airspace on Tuesday.

item.title: Hostage situation reported in Colombia as armed men flee into supermarket
item.description: President Abelardo de la Espriella says police and military have been deployed as situation unfolds in Cartagena.

item.title: Brazil doctor uses surfboard and sledgehammer in flood rescue
item.description: A Brazilian doctor is being hailed a hero after rescuing an old man from severe flooding using a surfboard

item.title: Libya’s Haftar visits Turkiye days after Ukraine hits Russian warship
item.description: Ahead of Erdogan’s Libya trip, Haftar’s visit suggests Turkiye seeks another way to bring the country's rivals together.

item.title: US Army to detonate more than 4 tonnes of lead azide in Iowa on Wednesday
item.description: Despite alarm about toxic lead, federal officials say destroying the unstable explosives is the safest course of action.

item.title: Iraq targets oil smugglers, orders Kurdish oilfield takeover
item.description: Iraq's Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has ordered federal forces to take control of oilfields in Kurdish-controlled areas.

item.title: Turkish military helicopter crash kills five in western Turkiye
item.description: The Defence Ministry did not elaborate on the cause of the crash, days after another deadly army helicopter accident.

item.title: Putin says retaliation ‘inevitable’ after Ukraine hit Russian oil plants
item.description: Ukrainian attacks subsided after Trump's mid-October declaration of an energy ceasefire, but picked up again afterwards.

item.title: China Southern Airlines unit to buy 50 Boeing 737-8 planes
item.description: The agreement marks the US planemaker's first major order from China in almost a decade.

item.title: US House counsel denies backing controversial raid on Ilhan Omar’s home
item.description: Legal counsel challenges DOJ's assertion of House's involvement in controversial raid on Ilhan Omar's home.
